source_scope: Selected source paths only; local caches, installed dependencies and private artifacts excluded.

limits: Exact-pin checks use declared versions only and do not resolve a complete runtime environment.

Ranges, includes, OS conditions, Go graphs, other npm applications, container bases, charts and infrastructure providers need separate environment-specific resolution, vulnerability and license checks.
No runtime installs, scans, deployments, images, packages, models, or binary redistribution are approved by the preview audit.
